customer: So we've been talking about getting something bigger since the family keeps growing, and I figured I'd sell my electric car to Northwind first, but then I went digging through the filing cabinet and the title is just gone, no idea where it ended up, maybe it got tossed during the move last year? I'm in North Carolina if that matters. Can I still sell it to you or am I stuck until I find that paper?
agent: No problem. Since North Carolina issues paper titles, you can request a duplicate by mail or at any North Carolina motor vehicle office, and you'll need your registration and a photo ID. Duplicates take 4 to 6 weeks to arrive, but in the meantime you can still get an offer and book an appointment with us, though we can't complete the purchase until the duplicate arrives. Offers last a limited time, so you may need a new one when the title comes in; our article "How long is my offer good for?" explains more.
